name: core--bg-laws-deploy
description: Deploys the bg-laws pipeline runtime to vm700 per bg-laws-pipeline/docs/spec/80-queue-worker-admin.md section 4: bglaws user (no sudo), bun from the official tarball at /usr/local/bin/bun, git clones of bg-laws-pipeline and the bg-laws data repo under /opt/bg-laws, the var/queue + var/admin state dirs, a 0600 env file (no LLM key on the host — OPENROUTER_API_KEY referenced but empty by default), backfill.sh + incremental.sh wrappers sharing one flock file, a daily incremental cron in /etc/cron.d, and logrotate for /opt/bg-laws/logs. The backfill itself is NOT started by the role — it is operator-started inside tmux, once.

implementation.change: New role bg-laws (tasks, defaults, templates for env/backfill.sh/incremental.sh/start-backfill.sh/cron/logrotate), wired into the ops play of playbook-index.yaml under tag bg_laws. Private repos are cloned over ssh with the existing protected/keys/docker/homelab-docker.key convention (same key the ops-settings role uses for helmfile-home-lab) — no new secret mechanism. Repo updates are fetch + ff-only merge under flock -n so a running backfill is never yanked out from under itself; the data repo is never merged at all (the runner owns that tree, spec 4.7).

checks: PENDING: playbook run against vm700 completes
PENDING: bun --version exits 0 on vm700 at /usr/local/bin/bun
PENDING: both repos present under /opt/bg-laws with the expected origin URLs
PENDING: 'bun run src/cli/main.ts version' exits 0 as bglaws with /opt/bg-laws/env sourced (bare --help exits 1 by design, E_USAGE)
PENDING: /etc/cron.d/bg-laws installed with the flock-guarded incremental line
PENDING: logrotate stanza present; var/queue/{pending,leases,done,failed} and var/admin exist, owned bglaws
